meta.description: Structures biological experiments around experimental units, randomization, blocking, factorial designs, split plots, nested designs, and matching analysis models.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numbers in the audit were produced from labelled synthetic data or a byte-identical shipped example.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill stays within research-design advice and makes no individual diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: The tested outputs correctly prevent pseudoreplication and use the whole-plot error stratum for split plots.

code_usability.detail: The exact designit constrained-allocation block fails on designit 0.5.1, within the declared 0.5+ support range: some sample columns match BatchContainer dimension names.

functional_suitability.note: Experimental-unit, blocking, factorial, and split-plot guidance is strong, but the advertised constrained designit workflow fails.

reliability.note: Seeded examples and caveats are sound, but the version-compatibility guidance does not protect a current supported designit invocation.

performance_context.note: The primary Skill is compact and the usage guide remains separated from agent-facing detail.

agent_usability.note: Decision tables, goals, and models are clear; there is no verified recovery path for the constrained allocator.

human_usability.note: Explanations are clear, though usage-guide.md is less useful as a standalone quick reference.

security.note: No secrets, destructive operations, raw-string execution, or injection surface were found.

maintainability.note: The source has a version note, but its only designit block was not retained as a passing implementation for the claimed support range.

agent_specific.note: Trigger conditions, scope handoffs, and scenario-based routing are precise and composable.

key_strengths: The experimental-unit explanation and pseudoreplication refusal are direct and scientifically correct.
The shipped split-plot example runs and its whole-plot Type-I error warning was independently generalized.
Decision-tree scope handoffs prevent the Skill from pretending to solve sequencing-batch allocation.
Seeded manual randomization, blocked factorial, and Latin-square patterns produced checked outputs.

recommendations.title: Repair the designit constrained-allocation block
recommendations.problem: The exact SKILL.md block errors on designit 0.5.1 because the samples and BatchContainer share the column name block, so it never produces a constrained layout.
recommendations.root_cause: The example was not maintained as an end-to-end tested implementation for its declared designit 0.5+ support range and has no bounded optimizer configuration.
recommendations.fix: Rebuild the block from the installed designit 0.5.1 vignette with non-colliding sample and container fields and explicit bounded optimization controls. Execute the literal documented block to a checked layout before a fresh re-audit.
